clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —Requirements of manufacture, dimensions and marking for fabricated PVC flanged tail pieces  with metallic flange for portable water supplies.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Requirements —The general requirements for materials, sizes, methods of test, sampling and critieria for conformity shall conform to IS 10124 (Part 1) : 1988.

clauses.title: Marking
clauses.text: 4. Marking—  The flanged tail piece with metallic flange shall be marked in colour as indicated below for different classes of fittings : Class of Fitting Colour Class 1 (0.25 MPa) Red Class 2 (0.4   MPa) Blue Class 3 (0.6   MPa) Green Class 4 (1.0   MPa) Yellow SUMMARY OF IS 10124 (PART 6)  : 1988 FABRICATED  PVC FITTINGS FOR POTABLE  WATER SUPPLIES PART 6  SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS  FOR  FLANGED TAIL PIECES WITH METTALLIC FLANGES (First Revision) Note— This figures is  intended to define the terms used in Table 1 and is not intended to illustrate specific design features FIG 1  PVC  FLANGED  TAIL  PIECE WITH  METALLIC  FLANGE Note — Fabricated tail pieces for sizes 225 mm and above are not generally recommended. For  0.25 MPa pressure class, fabricated tail pieces shaould not be made from 0.25 MPa (Class 1) pressure class pipes.  For this, tail pieces made from 0.4 MPa (Class 2) pressure class pipe should be used. For detailed information, refer to IS : 10124 (Part 6) : 1988 Specification for  fabricated PVC fittings for potable water supplies: Part 6  Specific requirements for flanged tail pieces with metallic flanges  (first revision).
